name: Junk Simulator [BETA]
desc:
NEW MINING HELMET UPDATE!

🎉 Welcome to Junk Simulator! Grab a shovel, some bombs and dig down into the junk pit to find valuable junk. Sell your junk and dirt for cash, use this to upgrade your shovel, backpack, pets and more!

❗❗ Players in the Cat Ocean Games group get a 10% sell boost! ❗❗

❗❗ Premium users get a 25% sell boost and 2 scrap per click at the Junk Pile! ❗❗

👍 Make sure to LIKE the game, new code at 10k likes for free SCRAP and CASH! 👍

Please note, this game is in BETA, bugs are expected
